job.title: Data Analyst
job.description:
Analyst (Christchurch or Auckland)
We're looking for a commercially savvy analyst to support major capital investment programmes by gathering, validating and analysing complex financial and operational data.

What you'll be doing

  • Analyse financial, asset and operational data from multiple sources
  • Identify gaps and develop insights to support business and investment cases
  • Engage with stakeholders to gather and test assumptions
  • Produce clear, concise reports and recommendations for decision-makers
  • Turn complex data into meaningful commercial insights

What we're looking for
You could be a:

  • Senior Management Accountant
  • Commercial Analyst
  • Data Analyst
  • FP&A Analyst
  • Investment Analyst

You'll bring:

  • Strong analytical and financial modelling skills
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • A naturally inquisitive mindset with confidence to challenge and probe
  • The ability to distil complex information into clear recommendations


If you're a numbers-driven problem solver who enjoys uncovering insights and influencing decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Data Warehouse Developer
job.description:
Senior Data Engineer
Lead the design and evolution of modern cloud data platforms

  • Play a key role in a large-scale data platform modernisation programme
  • Work with modern technologies such as Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure, Python and SQL
  • Permanent Wellington-based opportunity with flexible working and a collaborative team environment

About the Opportunity
Working within a collaborative team of Data Engineers, Developers and Analysts, you'll provide technical leadership across the full data lifecycle. This is a hands-on senior role where you'll design and build scalable data platforms, optimise existing solutions, mentor team members, and help shape best practices for data engineering across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain complex data engineering solutions and data pipelines
  • Develop cloud-based data platforms and products with a focus on scalability, security and cost optimisation
  • Create and maintain data integration and transformation processes using modern cloud technologies
  • Develop high-quality Python applications, reusable components and automated data solutions
  • Lead code reviews and contribute to engineering standards and best practices
  • Monitor, optimise and enhance existing data pipelines and platform performance
  • Design and implement dimensional data models and database solutions
  • Lead the selection and adoption of data engineering tools, technologies and methodologies
  • Contribute to data governance, security, architecture and compliance standards
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring and guidance to other engineers within the team
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions

About You
You'll be an experienced Senior Data Engineer with a passion for building modern, scalable data platforms and a track record of delivering complex data solutions.
You'll bring:

  • Strong experience designing and building enterprise-scale data platforms
  • Expertise with Databricks, Azure Data Factory and the wider Azure data ecosystem (Snowflake and Fabric are also valuable)
  • Advanced SQL and database design skills
  • Strong Python development experience
  • Experience with dimensional data modelling and data warehousing principles
  • Knowledge of cloud architecture, security and governance practices
  • Experience leading technical initiatives and mentoring other engineers
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and problem-solving skills


If you're passionate about data engineering, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Test Engineer
job.description:
Test Engineer | Fixed Term Contract | 18months

Are you a hands-on Test Engineer who enjoys building robust automation frameworks, validating complex data, and ensuring critical systems perform as expected?

We're looking for an experienced Test Engineer to join a major transformation programme where you'll play a key role in delivering high-quality outcomes across banking and financial services products. This is an opportunity to work on complex integrations, data migrations, and API-driven solutions in a collaborative, delivery-focused environment.

What you'll be doing
As a Test Engineer, you'll be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated testing solutions that ensure systems are reliable, accurate, and fit for purpose. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, developers, and delivery teams to validate business requirements, improve test coverage, and support successful releases.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Building and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites
  • Designing and executing API, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Validating complex business rules, calculations, and financial transactions
  • Performing migration and reconciliation testing across source and target systems
  • Querying and analysing data to validate outcomes and identify discrepancies
  • Supporting SIT and E2E testing activities, including defect triage and troubleshooting
  • Contributing to CI/CD pipelines and continuous quality practices
  • Ensuring clear traceability between requirements, test scenarios, and automation coverage

What you'll bring
We're looking for someone with strong technical testing capability combined with experience working in financial services or banking environments.
You'll ideally have:

  • Strong experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Postman, Bruno, NUnit/C#, Selenium, Cypress, RestAssured, or Karate
  • Solid programming skills in Java and/or Python
  • Experience testing REST and SOAP APIs, including JSON and XML validation
  • Strong SQL and database querying skills
  • Experience using Git and modern version control practices
  • A proven track record delivering automation within CI/CD environments such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions
  • Strong troubleshooting and defect investigation skills

Highly desirable experience

  • Banking, financial services, lending, payments, or core banking platforms
  • Data-driven testing approaches and parameterised automation frameworks
  • Data migration, reconciliation, and validation testing
  • Testing financial calculations, interest accruals, fees, or transaction processing
  • BDD frameworks and tools such as Gherkin or Cucumber

Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion.

Key Skills
Test Automation | Playwright | Postman | Selenium | Cypress | API Testing | Python | Java | SQL | Git | CI/CD | Jenkins | GitHub Actions | Data Migration | Reconciliation Testing | Banking | Financial Services | BDD | Cucumber | Gherkin

job.title: ServiceNow Developer
job.description:
Experienced ServiceNow Developer with strong expertise across ITSM and CSM, specialising in development, configuration, scripting, and enterprise service delivery improvements. Proven experience designing and implementing scalable self-service solutions, service catalogues, and operational workflows to improve user experience and business efficiency.

Key experience includes:

  • Development and configuration across ITSM and CSM environments, including scripting, workflow automation, and platform enhancement initiatives
  • Designed and launched an Employee Center Portal featuring custom-built widgets using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to improve employee self-service capability and user engagement
  • Built operational processes, dashboards, and scheduled jobs to support software licensing management, security compliance, data integrity, and reporting requirements
  • End-to-end ownership of a self-service cart platform, including scoping, development, and deployment for software, hardware, uniforms, POSDs licences, and field service-related supplies
  • Experience supporting field service operations through service catalogue design, fulfilment workflows, and inventory request processes
  • Implemented structured taxonomy models and microsite capability to improve platform navigation, searchability, and content discoverability across enterprise environments
  • Strong understanding of service management best practices, user-centric design, and process automation within complex organisational settings
